text:
Sorry about the double charge, that's frustrating. First, check whether one of the two is just a pending authorisation, since cards are authorised at checkout and charged when the order ships (an order shipped in several parcels can also show one charge per parcel).

If both charges have actually posted, reply with your order number (LF- plus six digits) and the last four digits of the card. Once we confirm the duplicate, it's refunded within 3 business days. Please don't send a full card number, security code or password.
